why: Every daemon HTTP method and route pair, classified for seat identity provenance (plan 221 AC1, PRD 003 req-10, F88). Refreshed from the F88 note (63 pairs at a0ec952) to main, plus POST /v1/requests (#149), POST /v1/steer (#152) and the implicit HEAD pair axum serves for every GET route. `just route-inventory-check` probes the routes the daemon really serves (Endpoint::ALL through the router) and fails on a served pair missing here, an entry the daemon does not serve, a duplicate, or an entry without a valid classification.

authorities.machine-public: Any holder of the daemon key, by explicit policy (the reason says why); no seat's authority is granted.
authorities.seat-authority: The route acts with a seat's authority, resolved from caller claims; phase 2 gates these on the per-incarnation capability.
authorities.job-token: Authenticated by its own per-job secret, never the daemon key.

classes.send-as: Sends, FYIs and role requests attributed to a seat.
classes.inbox-claim: Claims, acknowledges or renews a recipient's deliveries.
classes.role-and-holder: Role, parent, holder, owner and prime actions.
classes.activity: A seat's own status, activity and reports.
classes.controls: Lifecycle and control actions on a seat or its jobs.
classes.adoption: Adopts a pane or reclaims a seat.
classes.attribution: Any-seat writes where impersonation forges only the author.

guards.R: Registered-seat resolver: existence, tombstone, and with a pane, ownership and claim consistency. Does not identify the requesting process.
guards.B: Hook binding: seat, pane and session claims agree with a live descriptor.
guards.N: Native tuple: session, pid and start match the registered incarnation.
guards.S: Shim caller: R plus optional Codex-session contradiction and paneless tuple and liveness checks.
guards.C: Control admission: a caller pane, its harness subtree re-observed, target and control policy.
guards.P: Provenance exception: connection address, lsof and ancestry prove descent from the harness (paned non-Claude adopt with an explicit harness session only).
guards.A: Asserted: the claimed identity is taken as given.
